ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How the scoreboard key works and what players see on the board.
ADMIN_C_PLAYERS_DESC: Player ids help reports; names are often hidden on roleplay servers.
ADMIN_H_IDS: The server id of each player.
ADMIN_C_JOBS_DESC: How many members of these jobs are on duty.
ADMIN_C_KEY_DESC: The key itself (HOME unless changed) is set in ai-core's Keybinds tab under "Show the scoreboard"; players can still rebind it in GTA Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM.
ADMIN_H_KEY_MODE: Hold: the board shows while the key is held. Press: one press opens it, the next press closes it.
